data.name: Florus
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'flos' meaning flower. In ancient Rome, Florus was a common name for those born under the sign of the golden flower, Jupiter. Florus was also a surname for the wealthy, indicating prosperity and abundance.

in_hebrew.name: פלורוס
in_hebrew.meaning: פרי, פורח, פורה, חג, חגיגה, תפארה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פלורוס (Florus) היא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'פרי', 'פורח', 'פורה', 'חג', 'חגיגה', 'תפארה'. השם נגזר מהשם הלטיני 'Florus' שמשמעותו 'פרי' או 'פורה'. במסורת הנוצרית, השם 'Florus' מיוחס לאחד מהאפיפיורים של הכנסייה הקתולית. שם זה נשמע בעברית כ'פּלוּרוֹס' והוא נחשב לשם נאה ומשמעותי. בביטוי: 'פרי ופורה' נמצא שימוש במילים 'פלורוס' ו'הלא'

in_greek.name: Φλόρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Φλόρος (Floros) είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει 'πλούτος', 'πλούσιος', 'πλούτη', 'ευλογία', 'εὐλογητός'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την Λατινική λέξη 'Florus' που σημαίνει 'πλούτος' ή 'πλούσια'. Στη Χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα 'Φλόρος' συνδέεται με έναν από τους Παπικούς της Καθολικής Εκκλησίας. Το όνομα 'Φλόρος' φωνάζεται ως 'Φλόρος' στην Ελληνική και θεωρείται όνομα όμορφο και σημαντικό. Στη λέξη: 'πλούτος και ευλογία' χρησιμοποιούνται οι λέξεις 'Φλόρος' και 'Εὐλογημένος'

in_latin.name: Florus
in_latin.long_meaning: Florus est nomen Latinum quod significat 'flos', 'florem', 'flores', 'felicitas', 'beatus'. Nomen hoc ab 'flos' derivatur, quod significat 'flos' vel 'florem'. In traditione Christiana, nomen 'Florus' cum uno ex Papis Ecclesiae Catholica coniungi solet. Nomen 'Florus' ut 'Florus' pronuntiatum est in Latina et est nomen decorum et significativum. In locutione: 'felicitas et beatus' 'Florus' et 'Beatus' utuntur'

in_english.name: Florus
in_english.meaning: flower, flowering, fruitful, blooming, prosperity, blessed
in_english.long_meaning: Florus is a Christian name derived from the Latin word 'flos' meaning 'flower', 'blooming', 'fruitful', 'prosperity', and 'blessed'. In Christian tradition, the name 'Florus' is associated with one of the Popes of the Catholic Church. The name 'Florus' is pronounced as 'Florus' in English and is considered a beautiful and meaningful name. In the phrase: 'prosperity and blessed', the words 'Florus' and 'Blessed' are used. The name 'Florus' is associated with qualities of abundance, fertility, and spiritual growth. It is a popular name in Christian cultures worldwide.

saint_reference.note: Saint Florus was a 4th-century Pope of the Catholic Church. He is known for his piety and his role in promoting the Christian faith in Rome.

data.cultural_impact: In Christian tradition, Florus the Martyr is a venerated Saint who patronized the city of Oranie, Algeria. He was put to death during the Severan persecution (early 3rd century AD) for refusing to renounce the Christian faith. Florus' life and legacy serve as a reminder of the steadfastness and resilience of early Christian martyrs in the face of persecution. The name Florus can symbolize strength, endurance, and faith in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Florus can represent spiritual growth and transformation, like a blooming flower. In the biblical parable of the mustard seed, the nature of God's Kingdom is described as a small seed that grows into a large tree (Matthew 13:31-32). Florus can also serve as a reminder of our connection to the natural world and the divine beauty within it that inspires our faith.

historical_references.reference: Florus was a Roman praetorian prefect during the reign of Emperor Diocletian in the late 3rd century.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Florus continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Florus, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Florus meaning "Golden flower" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Florus is a Latin name meaning "to bloom" or "flowering". It symbolizes the growth and renewal found in the Christian faith, as believers are called to continuously blossom in their faith and Spirit-filled lives.
